versions.content: If SecOC R xSecuredPduCollection is used then SecOC shall not perform any verification until it has received both the Authentic I - PDU and Cryptographic I - PDU which make up the Secured I - PDU. Only after both have been received SecOC shall attempt to verify the resulting Secure I - PDU. If SecOC_VerifyStatusOverride is used, the verification result and I - PDU are handled according to overrideStatus value.
